messages:
ana: Quick: we need one clear benchmark story for launch that works across blog, webinar, and product page. Propose: 'predictable cost & tail' as the headline.

kevin: Agree. Suggest a single hero chart: x-axis = cost per 1k tokens, y-axis = p95 latency with two series (baseline vs redwood-config). Add an inset showing cache hit impact.

sara: For headlines, use ranges not absolutes: '2x-3.5x typical cost reduction; p95 often halved.' Add methodology blurb: replayed anonymized production traffic, 15k sessions.

ben: Routing: CTA "See benchmarks" -> gated whitepaper (AE follow-up); "Try API" -> sandbox. Webinar: 20m demo, 20m SRE deep-dive, 10m customer Q&A. Need design mocks and one customer quote.

ana: Action items: kevin -> chart mock by Mon; sara -> draft hero text and methodology by Tue; ben -> set up gated form + routing. marketing-bot: added to Friday content review. :white_check_mark:
